chapter.verse: Kenkhrea khua-ah a om pawlpi nasem numei ahi, i sanggamnu Foebe note kiangah kong tungsak hi.

Misiangthote in ahih ding a kilawm bangin, Pasian hangah tua numei na tungsak un la, amah huh dinga a kisapnate khempeuh na huh ta un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in mi tampi ahi zongin, keimah ahi zongin hong huh mi ahi hi.
Kei tawh kibang Khazih Zeisu’ nasem khawm Prisilla leh Akuila na hopihsak un.
Amaute in keima nuntakna tang ding amau ngawng a dawh ngamte ahi uh hi. “Amau in hehpihna a nei uh hi,” ci-in kei guak hi lo, Gentail pawlpite khempeuh in a phat uh hi.
Amau inn sungah a om pawlpi zong na hopihsak un. Asia gamah Khazih ading a gah masabel ka it Epainetas zong na hopihsak un.
Note nasem a hahkat Mari na hopihsak un.
Kei tawh thongkia khawm, keima behte ahi Andronikas leh Junias zong na hopihsak un. Amaute in sawltak lakah maiphatna a ngah mi ahi uh a, kei mai-ah Khazih’ sunga om mite ahi uh hi.
Pasian hangah ke’n ka it Amflias na hopihsak un.
Kote tawh Khazih’ nasem khawmpa Urbanas leh ka it Stakhus zong na hopihsak un.
Nungzui taktak ahi Epelles leh Aritobulus’ innkuante zong na hopihsak un.
Ka beh Herodion leh Narkissas’ innkuante lakah Topa nung a zuite zong na hopihsak un.
Topa’ nasemte ahi Trifana leh Trofosa na hopihsak un. Topa’ nasem ahi it ding a kilawm numei Persis zong na hopihsak un.
Topa’ teelsa Rufas leh a nu ahi, ke’n zong nu ka cih, na hopihsak un.
Asinkritas, Flegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas akipan, amaute tawh a omkhawm sanggamte na hopihsak un.
Filologas, Julia, Nereas leh a sanggamnu leh Olimpas akipan, amaute tawh a omkhawm misiangthote na hopihsak un.
Khat leh khat siangtho kinapna tawh na kihopih un. Khazih’ pawlpite khempeuh in note hong hopih uh hi.
Ute naute aw, na san’sa uh thuhilhna tawh kituak lo, kikhenna leh pukna a bawl thei mite ciamteh un la, tang un, ci-in kong thuum hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite Topa Khazih’ na sem loin amau gilpi na bek a sem uh a, kamsiam leh kamzol tawh a pha mite a kheem thei uh hi.

Note’ thuman’na in mi khempeuhte lakah kithang ahih ciangin, note hangin ka lung a dam hi. Ahih hangin note in thuhoih lamsang ah lungpilna nei-in, gitlohna lamsang ah mawhna a om loh nading ka hong deih hi.
Nopna hong pia Pasian in a sawt loin note khe nuai uh ah Satan a bawlsia ding hi. Eite Topa Zeisu Khazih’ hehpihna thupha in note tungah om ta hen.
Kei tawh na a semkhawm Timoti akipan ka behte ahi uh Lukias, Jason leh Sosipater-te in note hong hopih uh hi.
Hih lai a gelh keimah Tertias in Topa hangin kong hopih hi.
Kei ahi zongin, pawlpi khempeuh ahi zongin, zin hong do thei Gaias in note hong hopih hi. Khuapi dangka keem Erastas leh i sanggampa Kuartas-te in note hong hopih uh hi. (
I Topa Zeisu Khazih’ hehpihna thu note khempeuh tawh omkhawm ta hen.)

Tanglai tawntung kiseel khin a, tu-in kilangin mipawl khempeuh in um-in thu a man’ nading uh, kamsangte’ Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh tawntung Pasian’ thupiakna bangin Lungdamna Thu leh Zeisu Khazih hong kilatna hangin note hong kipsak zo Topa khat bek in,
pilna tawh a dim Pasian, Zeisu Khazih hangin a tawntungin minthan’na ngah ta hen! Amen.
